Integrity.//: Score-submission integrity. Mode governs the play-session tier ONLY (Off | Observe | Enforce); the absolute-range tier is always on and is what keeps int.MaxValue off a board. Observe is the default because two legitimate paths submit without a fresh session - ScoreSyncService replaying a score parked offline, and any round that outlives SessionTtlMinutes - and Enforce would silently drop exactly the scores the PWA's durable-submission design exists to protect. Read the Warning-level 'Score integrity:' lines, then flip to Enforce once they are quiet.
Integrity.//MaxCreditedSeconds: Ceiling on the elapsed time one session may vouch for, however old it really is. Without it the rate tier has an obvious hole: mint a session, wait, and the accrued wall-clock alone justifies an enormous point total.

ApplicationInsights.//: Connection string is empty by default — populated via env var APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING in deployed environments. Leave empty in local dev to disable telemetry; GET /api/diag reports the config state as applicationInsightsConfigured.

AI.//: Endpoint + deployments come from Key Vault (kv-poshared2, PoMiniGames--AI--*) in deployed environments. ValidateDeploymentsOnStartup lists the account's deployments and fails Production startup on a name that is not there — the check that would have caught the gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o phantoms before players did.
AI.//Deployments: Per-game (and per-task, 'game.task') deployment routing. Nested keys here win over the flat Key Vault secret PoMiniGames--AI--Deployments (the flat form only fills gaps). funquiz, couplequiz and couplequiz.similarity (the chat fallback for answer scoring) run on gpt-5.4-nano, the cheapest model in ModelPricing.cs. Not Phi-4-mini-instruct: measured 2026-08-07 it answers 429 RateLimitReached on the first call against this account.
AI.//FallbackDeployment: A second deployment tried once when a call's own deployment has failed for good (429, removed, circuit open). Empty = off. Use a model of the same capability class as the default, e.g. gpt-5-nano behind gpt-5.4-nano.

TokenBudget.//: Per-identity daily token ceiling across the whole AI surface. The 'ai-generation' rate limit (8 quiz starts per 15 s) shapes bursts but bounds no spend, so this budget is the real ceiling. Only the opt-in paid quiz paths (Fresh AI questions, the AI judge) draw on it.

Diag.//AiUsageAdmins: Operators (Entra object ids; not emails, which a multi-tenant sign-in does not verify) who see the full GET /api/diag/ai report outside Development: per-game calls, spend and deployment names across every player. Everyone else signed in sees only their own budget. Empty = nobody.

Jev.//: TypeSafe's Jev decision model on OpenRouter, an OPTIONAL paid brain for PoJevArena. Brain is Local (free rules, the default; the arena always plays) or Jev; paid calls happen only when Brain=Jev, an ApiKey is set and the player picks Jev in Settings. Jev matches ask only on a state change (at most every 2 s per unit) and reuse cached answers. The key is Key Vault secret PoMiniGames--Jev--ApiKey in deployed environments, or a local-only appsettings.Development.json value; never commit it. One unit decision = one call (~500 input tokens, ~$0.00002).

Dossier.//: Fighter dossier cards (GET /api/pobrawl/dossier). FetchWikipedia enriches the static facts with the free Wikimedia REST summary + portrait, cached CacheHours in memory; off, or on any failure, the static facts are served. Free, but a live network call, so every test host pins it to false (TestBudgetGuard).

PoFunQuiz.//: QuestionSource: Bank (free, default) or FreshAi. Fresh AI is served only to signed-in players while AllowFreshAi is true; everyone else gets the bank.

Features.//: QuestionSource: Bank (curated, free) or FreshAi. AnswerMatching: Smart (free) or AiJudge (model asked only about close calls). Paid options apply only to a signed-in host.

PoVoxelStrike.//: Startup GLB → voxel ingestion. Paths resolve against the content root when relative. On App Service (WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=1, read-only package mount) ConvertedPath must be overridden to a writable absolute path under %HOME%\data.
